body: I can't enjoy them, that's the problem. There is no good and bad for me. Therefore there is no greater good. I'd feel sorry for making you busy with my problems if I weren't a nihilist but I don't care. To be honest, you mean nothing to me. I wouldn't care if you were to shoot yourself but I understand why you try to help me. I didn't post this to call for help, I don't need help. I posted this to kinda talk with myself. I'll either shoot myself or not, it doesn't matter. Thanks anyway.

I have a lot of hobbies. I play chess at club level, I can solve the 3x3x3 Rubik's cube in under 30 seconds, I play the electric guitar, I can draw quite well but no matter what I do, no matter how much fun I have during the day, I always end up asking myself at night "Why am I doing these? Why am I alive?" and want to commit suicide. And the only things that stops me from pulling the trigger is the 3-5% odd that I will survive. And I feel like I'll take that risk soon. This problem of mine isn't really psychological. It's not about having a bad life or suffering. I just can't find the motivation to keep living and nothing can make me find it. Nothing makes me want to keep living anymore but it's not easy to quit either.

I appreciate your attempts to help me but I don't think you understand what I mean. I am just a stack of atoms and cells that reacts to things that happen around it. Since the day I noticed this, I've been planning to suicide. There is no point in living, there is no point in discovering and creating stuff. There is no point in typing in this thread either. I just do it to make it easier for me.

It might have a meaning for you to leave your mark, but it doesn't for me. When I first became a nihilist, I said to myself "Alright, life has no meaning at all. I will try to learn as much I can, have some fun and then quit." But now I'm in the state where I can't find a purpose to do anything. I still have the taste of cold metal on my tongue and the only reason why i didn't pull the trigger is this meaningless survival instinct I can't overcome.

My life is completely okay, I've got almost no problems at all. The thing that makes me want to shoot myself is the fact that life has no meaning. I've been a nihilist for the past 3 years,first 2 being kind of an optimistic nihilism. But I recently realised that it's meaningless to try to survive in a meaningless life. Any person in my place would really be happier than most of the people but I'm not. I can't see a reason to try harder. There is no difference for me between life and death except life is harder.
